attempts.sql: SELECT sp.symbol_id FROM auto_ontology_code.code.symbol_profile sp JOIN auto_ontology_code.code.files f ON sp.file_id = f.file_id WHERE sp.name = 'get_columns' AND sp.kind = 'method' AND sp.has_docstring = false AND f.is_test = false AND sp.in_test_file = false;

request:
Among the production database connector classes that directly subclass SQLDatabase (auto_ontology/connectors/base.py), excluding classes in test code (any file under a tests/ folder), which ones override get_columns with their own get_columns method that has no docstring of its own (a leading # comment is not a docstring)? Return the symbol ID of each such get_columns method.

Requested output columns: symbol_id (string).
Return exactly the requested output columns, using each requested name as the column alias, in the requested order. Return complete repository-relative file paths and complete symbol IDs exactly as stored. When the question asks which files, symbols or modules, return each distinct one once unless it asks for occurrences.
explanation: This query retrieves the symbol_id of get_columns override methods without docstrings in production database connector classes. It joins the symbol_profile table (containing method entities with name, kind, has_docstring flags) with the files table (containing file paths and is_test flag) on file_id. The WHERE clause filters for symbol name 'get_columns', method kind, absence of a docstring (has_docstring = false), and excludes test files (both in_test_file = false and files.is_test = false). The result gives the complete repository-relative symbol IDs of each matching get_columns method.
sql: SELECT sp.symbol_id FROM auto_ontology_code.code.symbol_profile sp JOIN auto_ontology_code.code.files f ON sp.file_id = f.file_id WHERE sp.name = 'get_columns' AND sp.kind = 'method' AND sp.has_docstring = false AND f.is_test = false AND sp.in_test_file = false;
